h2.button: What are your opening hours?

div.div:
• Ten Wellness for Men: Open daily from 8:30 AM to 4:30 AM
• Ten for Her: Open daily from 10:30 AM to 10:30 PM
We cater to both early risers and night owls for maximum flexibility.

h2.button: Where are you located, and is parking available?

div.div: We have multiple luxury branches across Kuwait, including Sharq – Sanabil Tower and Sabah Al Salem – The Tower. All locations have convenient access with nearby parking.

h2.button: How can I make a booking? Do you accept walk-ins?

div.div: You can book via phone call or WhatsApp. While walk-ins are welcome, we highly recommend advance booking to ensure your preferred time and therapist.

h2.button: What is your cancellation/rescheduling policy?

div.div: We kindly ask for at least 6 hours’ notice to cancel or reschedule, so we can offer the slot to another guest.

h2.button: Can I bring a companion with me during my visit?

div.div: For the comfort and privacy of all our guests, we kindly request that only those receiving a service enter the treatment area. Companions may wait in the designated lounge areas if available.

h2.button: Do you offer group bookings or private spa experiences?

div.div: Yes, we love celebrating special moments with our guests. Whether you're planning a birthday celebration, bridal shower, corporate retreat, or a wellness gathering with friends. Let us know in advance, and we’ll add thoughtful touches to make your visit extra memorable.

h2.button: Do you offer any food or beverage options during treatments?

div.div: While treatments don’t include meals, we offer complimentary herbal teas and detox water. For group bookings or events, we can arrange light refreshments upon request.

h2.button: Do you offer gift cards or vouchers?

div.div: Yes! We offer elegantly packaged gift cards, a thoughtful and luxurious gift, perfect for celebrating special moments or treating a loved one to a truly relaxing experience.

h2.button: Do you have loyalty programs or special promotions?

div.div: Yes, we regularly launch seasonal promotions and exclusive offers. Follow us on Instagram @tenspakw for the latest updates.

h2.button: What payment methods do you accept?

div.div: We accept K-Net, Visa, MasterCard, Tabby, cash payments, and MyFatoorah payment links.

h2.button: Can I pay in installments or through financing options?

div.div: We accept flexible payment methods such as Tabby for buy-now-pay-later convenience.

h2.button: Is gratuity (tips) included in the price?

div.div: Service charges are included, but tips are always appreciated as a gesture of appreciation to your therapist.

h2.button: What treatments do you offer?

div.div:
We offer a wide range of services including:
• Massages: Balinese, Thai, Deep Tissue, Hot Stone, Swedish, Sports, Reflexology, and more
• Skincare: Facials tailored for different skin needs
• Grooming: Manicure, Pedicure, Body Scrubs, and more
All services are tailored separately for men and women in dedicated branches.

h2.button: What’s the difference between the massage types?

ul.li: Balinese Massage: A medium-pressure massage that relaxes both the nerves and muscles at the same time. It aids in muscle recovery, helps the body feel relaxed, and stimulates blood circulation.
Swedish Massage: A light-pressure massage that relaxes the nerves, calms the body, reduces stress, and promotes blood circulation.

Aromatherapy Hot Stones: A light-pressure massage using oils extracted from natural plants. These are various blends, each with specific benefits that help improve mood and stimulate blood circulation.

Sports Massage: A strong-pressure massage that helps with recovery and boosts blood circulation. It is usually recommended for athletes or those who prefer firm pressure and stretching during the massage.
Deep Tissue Massage: A strong-pressure massage that focuses entirely on the muscles. It uses pressure and stretching techniques to break down muscle knots and activate blood circulation.

Thai Massage: Considered one of the strong types of massage, this technique is performed without oils. It mainly involves body stretches and pressure using the hands, elbows, and feet, helping improve flexibility and stimulate circulation.

Foot Massage (Reflexology): A massage that focuses on the soles of the feet, targeting pressure points that are connected to the body’s internal organs. It helps relax the body, improve blood flow, and reduce stress.

Back, Neck, Shoulder, and Head Massage: This massage targets the areas where we usually feel pain and tension — such as the neck, shoulders, back, and head. It helps release muscle tightness, soothes the nerves, and brings relief.

h2.button: How do I know which treatment is right for me?

div.div: Our expert advisors will help you choose the best treatment based on your goals—whether it’s stress relief, recovery, or relaxation.

h2.button: Can I personalize my spa experience?

div.div: Absolutely. From selecting your preferred aromatherapy scents and music to choosing the type of pressure or focus areas during your treatment, we’re happy to tailor the experience to your needs.

h2.button: How often should I get a facial?

div.div: We recommend facials every 3–5 weeks for optimal skin health. This routine allows us to monitor your skin as the seasons change and help you maintain a radiant, healthy complexion. During times of high stress or hormonal changes, such as menopause, your skin may become more unpredictable and prone to breakouts. In these cases, your esthetician may suggest more frequent treatments until your skin stabilizes.

h2.button: Are your products organic or natural?

div.div: We use high-quality, skin-safe products, many of which are organic, natural, or plant-based, carefully selected for their effectiveness and safety.

h2.button: Can I bring my own products for use during a treatment?

div.div: For safety and quality assurance, we recommend using our approved spa products. However, if you have allergies or special skincare needs, please inform us in advance and bring the products you'd prefer and we’ll assess them accordingly.

h2.button: Do you have a VIP or premium suite experience?

div.div: Yes, some of our branches offer private VIP suites for a more exclusive and indulgent spa experience. These include enhanced amenities, privacy, and extended time slots.

h2.button: Can I add enhancements to my treatment?

div.div: Yes, we offer a range of add-on enhancements such as hot stones, scalp treatments, aromatherapy oils, or extra focus time for specific areas. Our advisors will guide you based on your preferences.

h2.button: Do you offer home services?

div.div: Yes, home service is available for men across Kuwait. Enjoy the Ten Wellness experience in the comfort of your home.

h2.button: Are your services available for both men and women?

div.div: Yes. We have dedicated branches for men and women to ensure complete privacy and comfort.

h2.button: What do I need to prepare for a home service session?

div.div: We bring all essentials including massage beds, linens, and products. All you need is a quiet, clean space where the therapist can set up comfortably.

h2.button: Can I request a specific therapist for home service?

div.div: Yes, you may request a preferred therapist. We’ll do our best to accommodate based on availability and your location.

h2.button: Are home service treatments available for women?

div.div: Currently, home service is offered for men only, but we are working on expanding our services in the near future.

h2.button: Can I book multiple home services in one visit?

div.div: Yes, you can combine multiple treatments such as a massage, facial, and grooming services during one home visit. Please inform us in advance so we can schedule the appropriate time and resources.

h2.button: Do you provide treatments for elderly clients or those with chronic conditions?

div.div: Yes, our therapists are trained to work with elderly guests or those with chronic conditions such as arthritis, back pain, or limited mobility. Please let us know your condition so we can adjust the treatment accordingly.

h2.button: Can I book a home service for a special occasion?

div.div: Yes, we offer home spa experiences for special occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, or private celebrations. We can also provide curated wellness experiences for you and your guests with advance notice.

h2.button: Do you provide massage beds and equipment for home visits?

div.div: Yes, we bring professional-grade massage tables, clean linens, towels, oils, and all necessary equipment to ensure your treatment is just as luxurious as in our spa.

h2.button: How early should I arrive before my appointment?

div.div: We recommend arriving at least 15 minutes before your scheduled appointment to allow time for check-in, consultation, and preparation.

h2.button: What if I’m running late for my appointment?

div.div: If you arrive late, we’ll do our best to accommodate you. However, your treatment time may be shortened to avoid delays for the next guest.

h2.button: What should I wear during my visit?

div.div: Comfortable attire is recommended. For our services, we provide disposable wear, towels, and robes to ensure your comfort and privacy.

h2.button: Can I request a specific therapist?

div.div: Absolutely. We’ll do our best to accommodate your preferred therapist based on availability.

h2.button: Are showers and lockers available?

div.div: Yes, all branches are equipped with private showers and lockers for your convenience.

h2.button: Should I eat before a massage?

div.div: Avoid heavy meals at least 1 hour before and after your session for maximum comfort.

h2.button: What should I expect on my first visit?

div.div: From the moment you arrive, our team will ensure you feel relaxed and comfortable. You’ll be welcomed with a calming atmosphere and guided through a short consultation, where your therapist will learn about your preferences and any special concerns. Before your treatment begins, everything will be explained so you know what to expect. Whether you’ve booked a massage, facial, or wellness therapy, your first visit is all about helping you unwind, rejuvenate, and enjoy a personalized spa experience.

h2.button: Can I shower before or after my treatment?

div.div: Yes, all our branches are equipped with private showers available before or after your session. Showering before a massage is encouraged for hygiene and comfort.

h2.button: Is there a relaxation area I can use before or after my treatment?

div.div: Yes, select branches feature relaxation lounges where you can unwind with herbal tea and calming music before or after your session.

h2.button: What health and hygiene measures do you follow?

div.div: At Ten Wellness, we adhere to the highest international standards of hygiene and sanitation. Treatment rooms, tools, and equipment are thoroughly sterilized after each guest. Fresh linens, disposable wear, and individually sealed products are used for every session.

h2.button: Can I get a massage if I have a medical condition?

div.div: Please inform us in advance. We’ll adapt your treatment accordingly or request a doctor’s approval if needed.

h2.button: Are your therapists certified?

div.div: Yes, all our therapists are internationally trained, certified, and highly experienced.

h2.button: What hygiene protocols do you follow?

div.div: We maintain the highest hygiene standards, including sanitized rooms after every session, fresh linens, and strict protocols for staff and therapists.

h2.button: Are there any age restrictions for receiving treatments?

div.div: As per Kuwait labor law, guests must be at least 15 years old to receive spa services. Parental or guardian approval is required for younger clients where applicable.

h2.button: Can I visit the spa during pregnancy?

div.div: Yes, certain treatments are safe during pregnancy. Please inform us when booking so we can tailor your experience accordingly.

h2.button: Is smoking allowed in the spa?

div.div: No. We maintain a smoke-free environment for the comfort and well-being of all guests and staff.

h2.button: What is your satisfaction guarantee policy?

div.div: At Ten Wellness, your satisfaction is our top priority. If for any reason you are not satisfied with your experience during the session, you are welcome to end the treatment and leave without payment. We stand behind the quality of our services and are confident that you will leave feeling relaxed, refreshed, and valued.

h2.button: Do you offer a satisfaction guarantee?

div.div: Yes. If you are not satisfied during your session, you may leave without paying, that’s how confident we are in the quality of our services.

h2.button: Do your products come with a guarantee?

div.div: Yes. All our products are guaranteed for 1 year. If a product is damaged or unsatisfactory, you may return it.

div.p: Cannot find what you are looking for? We warmly invite you to contact us.
